mapper.sql: u.UserId, u.Username, u.Email, u.DisplayName, u.AvatarUrl, u.Role, u.Status, u.CreatedAt, u.LastLoginAt, u.BannedAt

where.if: AND (u.Username LIKE #{c.likePattern} OR u.Email LIKE #{c.likePattern} OR u.DisplayName LIKE #{c.likePattern})

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM dbo.[User] u
ORDER BY u.CreatedAt DESC, u.UserId DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT , u.BanReason, u.BannedBy AS BannedById, b.Username AS BannedByUsername, a.PenName AS Author_PenName, a.IsVerified AS Author_IsVerified, a.FollowerCount AS Author_FollowerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Story s WHERE s.AuthorId = a.UserId AND s.IsDeleted = 0) AS Author_StoryCount FROM dbo.[User] u LEFT JOIN dbo.Author a ON a.UserId = u.UserId LEFT JOIN dbo.[User] b ON b.UserId = u.BannedBy WHERE u.UserId = #{userId}
SELECT Status, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM dbo.AuthorRequest WHERE UserId = #{userId} GROUP BY Status
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.[User] SET Status = 'BANNED', BanReason = #{reason}, BannedBy = #{adminId}, BannedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME(), UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE UserId = #{userId} AND Status = 'ACTIVE' AND Role <> 'ADMIN'
UPDATE dbo.[User] SET Status = 'ACTIVE', BanReason = NULL, BannedBy = NULL, BannedAt = NULL, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE UserId = #{userId} AND Status = 'BANNED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.[User] (Username, Email, PasswordHash, DisplayName, Role) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, 'ADMIN')
mapper.select: SELECT IsVerified FROM dbo.Author WHERE UserId = #{authorId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.Author SET IsVerified = #{isVerified} WHERE UserId = #{authorId}
